findings.summary: Mock evidence bundles send partial modes and omit classification, versions, features and rules_evaluated; the UI reads only fields the mock sends, so nothing diverges. P4-1 is closed: the e2e gate evidence is on clean commit 70ac1a50 and no src or ui code changed after it. P4-8 checked: value formats are enforced at admission, migration 0007 is forward-only, checksummed and tenant-scoped.

Mock refusals reduce every cause to CONFLICT 409 with one scripted message and never produce the real triggers (stale run_revision, reused key); the server tests cover those paths, and the e2e proves the UI side only.
The mock's conversation and ThreadRun revisions approximate the server's per-transition revision; shapes match, but no advanced revision is exercised.
